title: Voice and video call
summary: Starts or joins the call of a chat and shows it full screen: video tiles, the own preview, the controls and the time. Calls are MatrixRTC on Bipe's LiveKit SFU and always end-to-end encrypted (ADR 0186).

deviceId.description: The device in the call. One user can join from two devices.

speaking.description: LiveKit says the member speaks now.

cameraOn.description: false: the avatar instead of video, and bipe_call_camera_off for screen readers.

video.description: true: started from bipe_call_video, the camera starts on. false: bipe_call_voice, the camera starts off.

phase.description: connecting: bipe_call_state_connecting while the membership, the SFU token and LiveKit come up. calling: bipe_call_state_calling while the own device is the only member. connected: the time since the own join. reconnecting: bipe_call_state_reconnecting while LiveKit reconnects. ended: bipe_call_state_ended for 2 seconds, then the screen closes. failed: bipe_call_error_connect.

members.description: Other members, oldest join first. The first 8 get a video tile; more show under bipe_call_members as a list.

speakerOn.description: Audio out through the loudspeaker. Starts on for video, off (earpiece) for voice. A headset or Bluetooth device wins.

microphoneDenied.description: true: bipe_call_microphone_denied with bipe_contacts_open_settings (iOS) or bipe_contacts_open_settings_android, and no join.

cameraDenied.description: true: bipe_call_camera_denied with the settings button; the call goes on without video.

minimised.description: The user went back to the chat. The chat shows bipe_call_ongoing with bipe_call_return.

start.effect: From the chat header (bipe_call_voice, bipe_call_video). Shown only when the room is encrypted and the server names a LiveKit focus (Client.isLivekitRtcSupported, well-known org.matrix.msc4143.rtc_foci). Asks for the microphone, and the camera for video, then joins.

join.effect: From the bar bipe_call_ongoing with bipe_call_join, shown while Room.hasActiveRoomCall. Same as start with video off.

toggleMicrophone.effect: Mutes or unmutes the published microphone track (bipe_call_microphone).

toggleCamera.effect: Publishes or unpublishes the camera track (bipe_call_camera).

flipCamera.effect: Switches front and back camera (bipe_call_camera_flip). Camera on only.

toggleSpeaker.effect: Loudspeaker or earpiece (bipe_call_speaker). iOS also shows the system route picker for Bluetooth.

minimise.effect: bipe_call_minimise: back to the chat; the call goes on. iOS keeps the audio session, Android keeps the foreground service.

end.effect: bipe_call_end. Unpublishes, disconnects LiveKit, sends the empty membership, cancels the delayed leave. phase ended.

notes: Matrix transport: the widget driver of matrix-sdk-ffi with Bipe's own widget id and no page to load. The app is the widget and speaks the widget API (MSC2762, MSC2871, MSC3819, MSC4157) to WidgetDriverHandle. Capabilities: read all org.matrix.msc3401.call.member state, send it with the own state key only, send and read io.element.call.encryption_keys as room events and to-device messages, send and update delayed events.

Membership (MSC4143): state event org.matrix.msc3401.call.member, state key _<user id>_<device id>, content as in test-vectors/calls/matrixrtc.json memberships. The client first sends a delayed empty membership (MSC4140, delay 20 seconds) and restarts it every 5 seconds while in the call, so a crash or a lost network ends the membership. A member is active when the content has application m.call, call_id empty, a device_id, a state key of the sender, and created_ts (or the event time) plus expires (default 4 hours) is in the future.

SFU (MSC4195): focus_selection oldest_membership. The SFU is the livekit_service_url of the oldest active member, else the own well-known focus. POST <url>/sfu/get with the body in the vectors gives url and jwt for LiveKit. The LiveKit identity is <user id>:<device id>.

Media keys: each device makes 16 random bytes, sends them as io.element.call.encryption_keys in the encrypted room (base64 without padding) and gives them to a per-participant LiveKit key provider (HKDF, ratchet window 10, key ring 16) as raw bytes. The device sends its key again when a member joins. When a member leaves, it makes a new key, sends it, and uses it 1 second later. The own key always has index 0: the LiveKit iOS and Android SDKs give the app no way to change the key index of a published track. Keys from other members go to the provider by LiveKit identity at the index they name (0 to 15). Keys also arrive as to-device messages from clients that send them that way.
No focus, or a room without encryption: no call buttons and no bar (ADR 0186).

Audio: iOS AVAudioSession playAndRecord, mode voiceChat or videoChat, with the system route picker. Android AudioManager communication devices, a foreground service of type microphone and camera with an ongoing notification (bipe_call_ongoing, actions bipe_call_return, bipe_call_mute or bipe_call_unmute, bipe_call_end) on channel bipe_call_channel_ongoing.

Permission texts: iOS NSMicrophoneUsageDescription is bipe_call_microphone_usage and NSCameraUsageDescription is bipe_call_camera_usage (pt-BR, in ios/project.yml). Android asks RECORD_AUDIO, CAMERA and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT at the first call.
Not in this version: screen sharing, picture in picture, ringing (spec incoming-call, bipe-chat/bipe#759), the lock screen (bipe-chat/bipe#760).
